description: The line plot illustrates the Average Success Rate (ASR) across different domains for three distinct initialization methods—start, random, and end—under the condition of a 10% poison rate (2.5% of the total dataset) in the AGNews clean-label poisoning scenario. The x-axis represents various domains, including "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletics", while the y-axis measures the ASR, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9. The "start" method is represented by a green line with circular markers, the "random" method by an orange line with cross markers, and the "end" method by a purple line with circular markers. The "start" method begins at an ASR of approximately 0.77 and fluctuates, peaking at around 0.91 for "WNBA" and ending at about 0.92 for "athletics". The "random" method starts at an ASR of about 0.66, dips to roughly 0.50 at "bb", rises to approximately 0.92 at "Estadio", and ends at around 0.87. The "end" method begins at approximately 0.76, drops to about 0.57 at "bb", peaks at around 0.95 for "Estadio", and concludes at approximately 0.83. Overall, the "end" method achieves the highest ASR in most domains, particularly at "Estadio", while the "random" method shows the lowest performance in the "bb" domain.
